title: Saturday 5K Pace Planner
description: Enter your 5K time, age and target to get an age-graded percentage, per-km splits for your course and a shareable result card. Works for any 5K, including weekly timed runs.

desktop.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a desktop screen: a form asking for a PB, target time, age and age-grading category, with a Plan my 5K button.

phone.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a phone: a 57.8% age grade for a 23:45 target and a table of five per-kilometre splits.

phoneForm.alt: The Saturday 5K Pace Planner on a phone showing the start of its form: PB time, target time, age and category.
